text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm Bubble Gum Fellow. Nice to meet you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I hereby declare: I'm going to become a 
strong Umamusume who will transform the 
racing world!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that, I won't hesitate for a 
second. Let's make our dream blossom 
together!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
